import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_availability_red_meat_poultry_fish.xlsx', sheet_name='Boneless', header=None)

# Find the header row containing Beef, Chicken
# In sheet 'Boneless': row 2 has Beef (col C, idx 2), Chicken4 (col H, idx 7), Year is col A (idx 0)
# Data starts around row 7 (idx 6)
year_col = 0
beef_col = 2
chicken_col = 7

data = df.iloc[6:119, [year_col, beef_col, chicken_col]].dropna()
data.columns = ['Year', 'Beef', 'Chicken']
data['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Year'])
data['Beef'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Beef'])
data['Chicken'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Chicken'])

exceeded = data[data['Chicken'] > data['Beef']]
first_year = int(exceeded['Year'].min())
result = str(first_year)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_availability_red_meat_poultry_fish.xlsx', sheet_name='Boneless', header=None)

# Year is in column A (0), Total2 is in column L (11)
df_data = df.iloc[6:120, [0, 11]].dropna()
df_data.columns = ['Year', 'Total']
df_data['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_data['Year'])
df_data['Total'] = pd.to_numeric(df_data['Total'])

row_2019 = df_data[df_data['Year'] == 2019]
result = float(row_2019['Total'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_availability_red_meat_poultry_fish.xlsx', sheet_name='Boneless', header=None)

# Red meats: Beef (col C/2), Veal (col D/3), Pork (col E/4), Lamb (col F/5)
meats = {'Beef': 2, 'Veal': 3, 'Pork': 4, 'Lamb': 5}

# Find row for 2019
years = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[6:120, 0], errors='coerce')
row_idx = years[years == 2019].index[0]

vals = {meat: float(df.iloc[row_idx, col]) for meat, col in meats.items()}
top_3 = sorted(vals, key=vals.get, reverse=True)[:3]
result = top_3

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_availability_red_meat_poultry_fish.xlsx', sheet_name='Boneless', header=None)

# Year is col 0, Chicken is col 7
data = df.iloc[6:120, [0, 7]].copy()
data.columns = ['Year', 'Chicken']
data['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce')
data['Chicken'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Chicken'], errors='coerce')

subset = data[(data['Year'] >= 2000) & (data['Year'] <= 2020)]
result = int((subset['Chicken'] > 60).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_availability_red_meat_poultry_fish.xlsx', sheet_name='Carcass', header=None)

# Year is col 0, Turkey is col 8 (I)
data = df.iloc[6:120, [0, 8]].copy()
data.columns = ['Year', 'Turkey']
data['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce')
data['Turkey'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Turkey'], errors='coerce')

subset = data[(data['Year'] >= 2010) & (data['Year'] <= 2019)]
result = round(float(subset['Turkey'].mean()), 2)
